== Overview ==

The Tagaya service provides the client with metadata about a digital titles updates and versions. The console uses this service to check if any installed eShop titles require updates.

<div style="background-color: rgb(234, 243, 255); border-color: rgb(163, 202, 255); border-style: solid; border-width: 1px; color: rgb(32, 33, 34); max-width: 800px; width: fit-content;">
<div style="background-color: rgb(203, 214, 246); font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; height: 24px; line-height: 24px; text-transform: uppercase; padding: 5px; padding-left: 20px;">Note</div>
<div style="padding: 5px;">''This service only applies the digital titles installed via the eShop. See [[Online/Nintendo_Network/SOAP|SOAP]] for how the console updates system titles and performs firmware updates.''</div>
</div>

<br>

<div style="background-color: rgb(234, 243, 255); border-color: rgb(163, 202, 255); border-style: solid; border-width: 1px; color: rgb(32, 33, 34); max-width: 800px; width: fit-content;">
<div style="background-color: rgb(203, 214, 246); font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; height: 24px; line-height: 24px; text-transform: uppercase; padding: 5px; padding-left: 20px;">Note</div>
<div style="padding: 5px;">''Each platform has it's own subdomains, however all endpoints are available to both platforms.''</div>
</div>

== Wii U ==

The following servers are used by the Wii U.

{| class="wikitable"
|-
! Server !! Description
|-
| https://tagaya.wup.shop.nintendo.net || Used by retail units to get the latest version list number/CDN address
|-
| https://tagaya.wup.eshop.nintendo.net || Seems to be a mirror of <code>tagaya.wup.shop</code>?
|-
| https://tagaya-wup.cdn.nintendo.net || Retail unit version list CDN. This server is not referenced in any client, the address is provided by the server and may change at any time
|}

=== Endpoints ===

{| class="wikitable"
! Method !! Path
|-
| <code>GET</code> || <code>[[#GET /tagaya/versionlist/%s/%s/latest_version|/tagaya/versionlist/%s/%s/latest_version]]</code>
|-
| <code>GET</code> || <code>[[#GET /tagaya/versionlist/%s/%s/list/%d.versionlist|/tagaya/versionlist/%s/%s/list/%d.versionlist]]</code>
|}

==== GET /tagaya/versionlist/%s/%s/latest_version ====

Retrieves the latest Wii U title version list number and the address of the title version CDN.

==== Request ====

===== URL Parameters =====

{| class="wikitable"
! Parameter !! Description
|-
| 1 || Region code (<code>USA</code>, <code>EUR</code>, <code>JAP</code>, etc.)
|-
| 2 || Country code (<code>US</code>, <code>GB</code>, <code>JP</code>, etc.)
|}

===== Headers =====

{| class="wikitable"
! Header !! Description
|-
| <code>Accept</code> || Always <code>*/*</code>. Changing this does nothing to the response
|}

==== Response ====

===== Headers =====

{| class="wikitable"
! Header !! Description
|-
| <code>Server</code> || <code>nginx</code>
|-
| <code>Date</code> || Date of the response. <code>Wed, 25 Feb 2026 18:52:06 GMT</code>
|-
| <code>Content-Type</code> || <code>application/octet-stream</code>
|-
| <code>Content-Length</code> || Length of the response body in bytes
|-
| <code>Connection</code> || <code>keep-alive</code>
|-
| <code>x-amz-id-2</code> || https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/API/RESTCommonResponseHeaders.html
|-
| <code>x-amz-request-id</code> || https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/API/RESTCommonResponseHeaders.html
|-
| <code>Last-Modified</code> || Date the version list was last modified. <code>Tue, 17 Nov 2020 23:45:02 GMT</code>
|-
| <code>x-amz-server-side-encryption</code> || <code>AES256</code>
|-
| <code>Accept-Ranges</code> || <code>bytes</code>
|}

===== Body =====

Latest Wii U title version list number and the address of the title version CDN. Despite being sent as <code>application/octet-stream</code>, the data is always XML.

<pre>
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?>
<version_list_info format_version="1.0">
  <version>1665</version>
  <fqdn>tagaya-wup.cdn.nintendo.net</fqdn>
</version_list_info>
</pre>

==== GET /tagaya/versionlist/%s/%s/list/%d.versionlist ====

Retrieves the specified Wii U title version list from the version list CDN. Older versions are available if a lower version list number is specified.

==== Request ====

===== URL Parameters =====

{| class="wikitable"
! Parameter !! Description
|-
| 1 || Region code (<code>USA</code>, <code>EUR</code>, <code>JAP</code>, etc.)
|-
| 2 || Country code (<code>US</code>, <code>GB</code>, <code>JP</code>, etc.)
|-
| 3 || Version list number from <code>[[#GET /tagaya/versionlist/%s/%s/latest_version|/tagaya/versionlist/%s/%s/latest_version]]</code>
|}

==== Response ====

===== Headers =====

{| class="wikitable"
! Header !! Description
|-
| <code>Server</code> || <code>nginx</code>
|-
| <code>Content-Type</code> || <code>application/octet-stream</code>
|-
| <code>x-amz-id-2</code> || https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/API/RESTCommonResponseHeaders.html
|-
| <code>x-amz-request-id</code> || https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/API/RESTCommonResponseHeaders.html
|-
| <code>Last-Modified</code> || Date the version list was last modified. <code>Tue, 17 Nov 2020 23:45:02 GMT</code>
|-
| <code>x-amz-server-side-encryption</code> || <code>AES256</code>
|-
| <code>Date</code> || Date of the response. <code>Wed, 25 Feb 2026 18:52:06 GMT</code>
|-
| <code>Content-Length</code> || Length of the response body in bytes
|-
| <code>Connection</code> || <code>keep-alive</code>
|}

===== Body =====

Specified Wii U title version list. Despite being sent as <code>application/octet-stream</code>, the data is always XML.

<pre>
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?>
<version_list format_version="1.0">
  <version>1665</version>
  <titles>
    <title>
      <id>0005000E10100600</id>
      <version>16</version>
    </title>
    <title>
      <id>0005000010100D00</id>
      <version>128</version>
    </title>
    ....
  </titles>
</version_list>
</pre>

== 3DS ==

The following servers are used by the 3DS.

{| class="wikitable"
|-
! Server !! Description
|-
| https://tagaya-ctr.cdn.nintendo.net || Used by retail units to get the latest version list number/CDN
|-
| https://tagaya-dev-ctr.cdn.nintendo.net ||  Used by development units to get the latest version list number/CDN. Not accessible anymore
|}

=== Endpoints ===

{| class="wikitable"
! Method !! Path
|-
| <code>GET</code> || <code>[[#GET /tagaya/versionlist|/tagaya/versionlist]]</code>
|}

==== GET /tagaya/versionlist ====

This is the only endpoint the 3DS uses to check for title versions. Unlike the [[#Wii U]], which separates the title version number and title version infos endpoints. This means that previous versions of the 3DS title version list are not natively accessible. The lack of URL parameters also means that the server cannot filter titles by region.

==== Request ====

===== Headers =====

{| class="wikitable"
! Header !! Description
|-
| <code>User-Agent</code> || [[Online/Nintendo_Network/BOSS|BOSS]] User-Agent
|}

==== Response ====

===== Headers =====

{| class="wikitable"
! Header !! Description
|-
| <code>Server</code> || <code>Apache</code>
|-
| <code>ETag</code> || https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTTP/Reference/Headers/ETag. The ETag structure is <code>"md5hash of the body:last modified unix timestamp"</code> (<code>"2c8e07edeb9156d8889598354e8a50ff:1509498002"</code>)
|-
| <code>Last-Modified</code> || Date the version list was last modified. <code>Wed, 01 Nov 2017 01:00:02 GMT</code>
|-
| <code>Accept-Ranges</code> || <code>bytes</code>
|-
| <code>Content-Type</code> || <code>text/plain</code>
|-
| <code>Content-Length</code> || Length of the response body in bytes
|-
| <code>Date</code> || Date of the response. <code>Wed, 01 Nov 2017 06:13:43 GMT</code>
|-
| <code>Connection</code> || <code>Keep-alive</code>
|}

===== Body =====

Latest 3DS title version list. Despite being sent as <code>text/plain</code>, the data is always binary.

The data is sent as a series of <code>0x10</code> byte blocks. The first block is always <code>01000000000000000000000000000000</code>. Following this block, every block until the end of the file has the following format:

{| class="wikitable"
|-
! Offset !! Size !! Description
|-
| 0x0 || 0x8 || Big-endian title ID
|-
| 0x8 || 0x4 || Little-endian title version
|-
| 0xC || 0x4 || Unknown. Usually all 0
|}

<pre>
00000000  01 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00
00000010  00 75 03 00 00 00 04 00 21 00 00 00 00 00 00 00
00000020  00 8b 03 00 00 00 04 00 10 04 00 00 00 00 00 00
00000030  00 a3 04 00 00 00 04 00 00 04 00 00 00 00 00 00
00000040  00 6c 05 00 00 00 04 00 20 1c 00 00 00 00 00 00
00000050  00 e3 05 00 00 00 04 00 20 08 00 00 00 00 00 00
00000060  00 ee 05 00 00 00 04 00 10 00 00 00 00 00 00 00
00000070  00 63 06 00 00 00 04 00 00 04 00 00 00 00 00 00
00000080  00 d1 06 00 00 00 04 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00
00000090  00 d7 06 00 00 00 04 00 01 00 00 00 00 00 00 00
000000a0  00 e4 06 00 00 00 04 00 00 04 00 00 00 00 00 00
...
</pre>
